neutral_modality_hypotheses.hypothesis: Inspect the supplied interval or intervals for an observable source-world change, relation, or continuity.
Inspect synchronized non-speech audio for a concrete source-world event without presuming that it is necessary.

alternative_route.prompt: Check the source for a shorter, clearer, or modality-substituting route to the same source-world fact.

duplicate.prompt: Check whether this lead duplicates another reviewed lead or repeats the same underlying source event.

far_coherence.prompt: When separated intervals are supplied, check whether they form one coherent source-world route; otherwise use NOT_APPLICABLE.

ocr_text.prompt: Check whether visible text, labels, displays, or OCR-readable content supplies an easier route.

recurrence.prompt: Check whether the same or a materially similar event recurs elsewhere in the source.

source_world_audio.prompt: Check whether synchronized non-speech audio carries a concrete source-world event rather than incidental recording noise.

substitution.prompt: Check whether another available modality or a simpler cue could replace the proposed route.
